capturedAt: 2026-09-25 11:56 MYT · Sep 24 completed-session prices + Sep 25 macro regime
title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining business quality, current price asymmetry, funding/rate sensitivity, technical location, theme significance and portfolio overlap. Sep 25 explicitly penalizes theme-only exposure in a 5%+ long-rate regime and promotes names where quality and price both improve.
marketRegime: Global duration + energy-inflation collision. Prefer cash-generative/contracted exposures and discounted quality; avoid chasing excellent themes at prices already above recent tape. Refined-product tightness and high sovereign yields simultaneously raise inflation and discount-rate risk.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price, business quality and current theme setup are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business/theme, but current price, tactical macro risk or overlap requires a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward or cyclical timing is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Financing, valuation, dilution or execution risk currently dominates.

candidates.name: Corteva
candidates.entry: Current high-$70s/low-$80s zone is materially better than early-September references; stage only if tape stabilizes
candidates.confirmation: Hold ~$79-80 then reclaim $82-83; stronger >$86-87
candidates.invalidation: Fundamental deterioration in seed/genetics pricing, farm margins or sustained technical breakdown
candidates.thesis: Premium seed/genetics is harder to defer than machinery and some crop-protection spend. Current price discount plus differentiated agriculture exposure produces one of the cleaner quality/price combinations in the stack.

candidates.name: Nutrien
candidates.entry: ~$72-74 remains the preferred research zone; stage only with stable fertilizer/farm-margin evidence
candidates.confirmation: Hold ~$72-74 and recover recent breakdown levels
candidates.invalidation: Farm affordability forces larger potash/phosphate volume cuts or sustained technical break
candidates.thesis: Valuation has improved into the original preferred area. Potash/phosphate is more deferrable than seed/nitrogen, so rank behind CTVA but keep on the active screen.

candidates.name: Cheniere Energy
candidates.entry: $270-278 preferred; avoid chasing above prior $293 confirmation without new contracting evidence
candidates.confirmation: New SPAs/utilization plus >$293, then ~$301
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$268 or material weakening in contracting/utilization economics
candidates.thesis: Contracted LNG diversification remains a differentiated energy-security exposure that does not require crude scarcity. Current price remains close to the preferred zone despite less immediate China-trade urgency.

candidates.name: Freeport-McMoRan
candidates.action: PRIORITY COPPER / GRID MATERIALS AT DISCIPLINED PRICE
candidates.entry: ~$70-72 preferred; ~$66-68 stronger value if macro liquidation deepens
candidates.confirmation: Stabilize in preferred zone; >$80.25 is major breakout rather than an entry requirement
candidates.invalidation: Physical copper demand/inventory thesis weakens or China/grid demand deteriorates materially
candidates.thesis: Price is near the original preferred zone while grid/electrification demand remains structurally supportive. Strategic-mineral framing is secondary; physical copper evidence remains the real thesis.

candidates.name: Cameco
candidates.entry: No new entry while making fresh lows; wait for stabilization and roughly $90-92 reclaim
candidates.confirmation: Reclaim ~$90-92 first; $95-100 stronger repair
candidates.invalidation: Persistent lower lows or deterioration in contracting/mine/Westinghouse execution
candidates.thesis: Strategic nuclear/fuel-cycle thesis remains high quality and valuation has improved, but the falling tape means discount alone is not enough.

candidates.name: CF Industries
candidates.action: WAIT FOR BASE — DISCOUNT IMPROVED, TAPE NOT YET
candidates.entry: Wait for stabilization and recovery of roughly $120-123 rather than catching the decline
candidates.confirmation: Hold $120-123; >$132 restores momentum
candidates.invalidation: Farm margins/input affordability weaken nitrogen demand or price continues making lower lows
candidates.thesis: Nitrogen is relatively difficult to defer and the price discount is now meaningful, but the speed of the decline requires a base before fresh capital.

candidates.name: GE Vernova
candidates.action: TOP-TIER FUNDED POWER/GRID · WAIT RETEST · GLOBAL-YIELD SHOCK, FUNDING/VALUATION GATES REMAIN
candidates.entry: Refresh price; require orderly retest or consolidation
candidates.confirmation: Backlog/order/FCF strength plus identifiable funded customer demand
candidates.invalidation: Power/Electrification backlog deterioration, margin reversal or material execution failure
candidates.theme: Gas power · electrification · grid · data-centre power
candidates.thesis: One of the cleanest physical-AI exposures because existing backlog and cash conversion reduce dependence on speculative requested MW. The Sep 21 filter is funded/contracted demand, not data-centre headlines alone. The renewed US/Japan long-yield shock is a valuation and funding headwind, but the Power Stack still requires contracted/funded demand, backlog conversion and valuation discipline. Sep 23 evening delta: stressed project finance and delayed pre-operating AI-infrastructure offerings increase the relative value of funded backlog, existing operating capacity and cash conversion; this improves selection quality but is not a reason to chase price.

candidates.name: Vistra
candidates.action: TOP-TIER RETEST WATCH / DO NOT CHASE
candidates.entry: $140–145 preferred; $145–148 only if support forms
candidates.confirmation: Sustain >$150; >$160 stronger
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$132 or hedge/PPA/generation deterioration
candidates.theme: Existing generation · peak load · AI power scarcity
candidates.thesis: Existing dispatchable generation, signed PPAs and funded counterparties remain exactly what the duration-constrained power regime rewards. Physical load evidence strengthened again, but entry discipline still matters.

candidates.name: Quanta Services
candidates.action: EXCELLENT GRID EXPOSURE / DO NOT CHASE

candidates.confirmation: Backlog/order/FCF strength plus funded customer demand
candidates.invalidation: Backlog/margin deterioration or capex cancellations

candidates.name: Eaton

candidates.confirmation: Orders/backlog/pricing remain strong with acceptable valuation
candidates.invalidation: Electrical backlog/margins deteriorate or valuation compresses without earnings catch-up

candidates.name: CrowdStrike
candidates.action: AI SECURITY QUALITY / TOO EXTENDED TO CHASE
candidates.entry: Wait for pullback/consolidation; do not convert a strong theme into a momentum chase
candidates.confirmation: ARR/bookings/renewals continue accelerating
candidates.invalidation: AI-security monetization fails to improve recurring economics
candidates.thesis: AI security is a preferred software branch, but the recent move has outrun the 15-session tape; retain the company, not the current entry.

candidates.name: Micron Technology
candidates.action: CHALLENGER THESIS ACTIVE · MEMORY SCARCITY / NO CHASE
candidates.entry: Wait for consolidation or a controlled retest after the vertical move
candidates.confirmation: HBM/DRAM pricing, customer contracts, supply discipline and cash conversion remain strong
candidates.invalidation: Capacity response, customer inventory correction, labor disruption or material memory-pricing reversal
candidates.thesis: AI memory remains an active scarcity branch and semiconductors retain leadership. Creator-reported bearish MU positioning is a challenger question only: verify the position/source, valuation, HBM/DRAM pricing, capacity response and cash conversion before changing the base score. The broader AI-credit repricing does not directly negate HBM scarcity, but it raises the hurdle for customer capex quality and cash conversion. The Trump-Xi summit adds an advanced-chip/export-control catalyst, but no thesis change should be made without specific policy language.

candidates.name: Tenaga Nasional
candidates.confirmation: >RM14.30 then ~RM14.90
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <RM13.00 or weakening regulated grid/DC economics
candidates.theme: Malaysia grid · regulated power · data-centre load
candidates.thesis: Malaysia data-centre demand is now observed load: data centres reached a record 9.3% of power use in mid-August. Regulated transmission/distribution remains a lower-duration way to own the buildout than speculative project developers.

candidates.name: Baker Hughes

candidates.name: Scorpio Tankers
candidates.entry: Do not chase war-risk spikes; wait for orderly pullback

candidates.name: Valero Energy
candidates.action: PRODUCT-TIGHTNESS RETEST · VERIFY CRACKS / NO CHASE
candidates.entry: No chase after extended run; wait for first orderly pullback
candidates.confirmation: Product cracks remain extreme with high refinery utilisation
candidates.invalidation: Rapid crack-spread and distillate normalisation
candidates.thesis: The highest-ranked macro theme directly supports VLO, but the stock already reflects much of the squeeze. Thesis stronger; entry discipline tighter. WTI below $90 increases the value of independently checking ULSD/3-2-1 and product inventories: downstream relative strength matters more than crude direction in this phase.

candidates.name: Marathon Petroleum

candidates.thesis: Strong direct beneficiary of limited spare refining slack, but price location remains the main problem. WTI below $90 increases the value of independently checking ULSD/3-2-1 and product inventories: downstream relative strength matters more than crude direction in this phase.

candidates.name: Phillips 66
candidates.action: PRODUCT-TIGHTNESS RETEST · VERIFY CRACKS / NO CHASE

WTI below $90 increases the value of independently checking ULSD/3-2-1 and product inventories: downstream relative strength matters more than crude direction in this phase.

priceCoverageNote: Fresh Sep 8-9 references are retained where already verified. New adjacent ideas require a fresh quote/valuation pass before action. Theme promotion never overrides entry discipline.
sweepNote: Sep 23 evening delta: no base company scores changed. The main update is a stricter funding-quality filter for AI infrastructure, a new agentic-intermediary research branch, and decomposed breadth/rates diagnostics.
creatorPolicy: Creator transcripts can generate mechanisms, tickers and verification questions but receive zero direct score weight.

macroDiagnostics.name: AI equity vs credit / project finance
macroDiagnostics.question: Can AI equities stay strong while project debt and AI-related credit spreads worsen, or does funding stress begin to feed into equity discount rates?

macroDiagnostics.name: Agentic disruption vs curve pressure
macroDiagnostics.question: Do wealth/intermediary names keep underperforming comparable rate-sensitive banks after controlling for the 2s10s curve?

macroDiagnostics.name: Rates decomposition
macroDiagnostics.question: If oil falls but front/belly rates stay firm, is the constraint shifting toward demand/real rates/issuance rather than energy inflation?

macroDiagnostics.name: Breadth decomposition
macroDiagnostics.question: Are weak 52-week highs/lows masking improving same-session and semiconductor breadth, or is leadership still too narrow?

macroDiagnostics.name: Physical vs financial energy
macroDiagnostics.question: Do ULSD/cracks/freight/refiners normalize with crude, or does product scarcity remain the inflation tail?

US-China summit.negativeIf: new restrictions, tariff re-escalation or no implementable detail

global duration.implication: Raise valuation and financing hurdles for long-duration / leverage-dependent names.
